# Build How-To: Bloodstained High INT Commando Nerd

![Build How-To: Bloodstained High INT Commando Nerd](/uploads/122_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This build is particularly suitable for **Double XP weekends**, or if you particularly like to level up and farm XP quickly and permanently. The focus of the build is clearly on the highest possible intelligence or the combination of **max XP and max intelligence**. This gives you e.g. During double XP weekends in West Tek for each super mutant **4000 experience points (EP)**. Essential for this build is the **Herbivore** mutation, as we are playing with plant food as XP buffs, as well as **Unyielding** armor and low HP.

## Equipment

This build takes advantage of the command perks unique to automatic rifles and actively plays the following rifles:

- B50crit15 Cleaner
- V50crit25 Cleaner
- Q50crit15CF cleaner
- and a few more depending on your mood

You can also use this build e.g. play with **heavy weapons**, **melee** or **shotguns**. **Pistols** can also work, but unfortunately you have significantly fewer options when it comes to mobility. Ultimately, you can distribute your damage perks to both perception and strength. This is no longer relevant for EP and intelligence. **Basically it's just a matter of killing the opponents somehow. Which weapon you use is not important.**

The **armor** is a thrown together set because I haven't yet gotten all the pieces as Secret Service armor with intelligence. Because the focus here is on intelligence:

- **All armor pieces** with **Unyielding** as the main effect and **+1 Intelligence** on the 2nd legendary slot.
- The 3rd legendary effect is not that important, HTD (harder to detect when sneaking) or weight reduction (weapons, food/chems or ammunition) also helps you.

The **underarmor** should be a **shielded casual underarmor** e.g. Undershirt and jeans (casual underarmor), as this armor best supports your intelligence. Values: +3 CHA, +3 INT and +1 LCK/GLÜ. 

If you don't have or can't get the shielded casual underarmor, you can alternatively use the **shielded Vault-Tec underarmor**: +1 STR, +1 END/AUS, +2 INT, +2 LCK/LUCK.

![](/uploads/build-high-int-underarmor-int-c4c8a87e-826b-46ca-883f-8631cdbd7e19.jpg)

In addition, the build uses a **backpack with pharmacist mod** (available from the raiders for gold), which replaces the perk card "Travel First Aid Kit" at 3*.

## Skillset

**Strength to 8:** 

Strongly built 2*, weapon belt 2*, strong as a bear 3*, strong back 1*

(In order to be able to carry more loot, except for the weapon belt, this can of course be varied. Strength is unimportant for the focus in this build.)

**Perception at 8 (+5 legendary WAH):**

Commando 3*, Professional Commando 3*, Master Commando 3*, Nighthawk 3*, Concentrated Fire 1*

**Endurance to 4:**

Radicool, Chem Fanatic 3*

(Chem Fanatics extend the duration of chems such as Berry Mentats for more INT)

**Charisma at 4:**

By the Dozen Weird, Inspirational 3

**Intelligence at 15 (+5 legendary INT):**

Nerd Rage 3, Weaponsmith 5* or Demolition Expert 5*, Portable Power 3*, Batteries Included 3, Recycler

(Nerdwut uses the optimal effects of low HP, Weaponsmith ensures more durability of the weapons, the rest is exchangeable and ensures less weight and more scrap when recycling; the 20 Intelligence gives you more XP)

**Agility / Agility to 5 (+5 legendary ATOM):**

Sneak 2*, Covert Operations 3*, Peng-Fu 1, Escape 1, Thru-Hiker 3*
